verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's CUDA Toolkit is the vendor toolchain for GPU compute (compiler, runtime, libraries, Nsight profilers), and independent Phoronix Linux tests ran 60+ CUDA/OptiX/OpenCL workloads on the RTX 5090, showing CUDA compute works on this card in practice. However, no first-party doc in the pack explicitly lists the RTX 5090 or Blackwell consumer parts as a supported CUDA target. missing for 10: an official CUDA supported-GPU or compute-capability listing naming the RTX 5090, and documented minimum toolkit and driver versions for this part.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship GPU-compute workloads on the vendor's toolchain — CUDA or ROCm/HIP documentation lists this part as a supported target

citations.quote: The toolkit includes GPU-accelerated libraries, debugging and optimization tools, a C/C++ compiler, and a runtime library.
across 60+ CUDA/OptiX/OpenCL/Vulkan benchmarks the 5090 delivered 1.42x the RTX 4090's performance
accelerate your gaming, creating, productivity, and development
